[[File:JediChefAnnouncer.jpg|thumb|200px|Announcing a [[MREM-02]] cooking battle.]]
An elegantly dressed individual was an '''announcer''' at [[Corpo (Hutt)|Corpo]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt's]] extravagant culinary contests. In his overly dramatic style, he introduced the challenger as well as Corpo's personal champion chef, [[MREM-02]].

==Behind the scenes==
Although never named in the comic, this announcer is based on the flamboyant character of [[Wikipedia:Takeshi Kaga|Chairman Kaga]] on [[Wikipedia:Iron Chef|''Iron Chef'']], who announces the theme ingredient for each battle.
